title: Yellow Creamy Southern Thai Lardons Kanom Jeen
description: A winey and creamy Southern Thai dish featuring khus khus and lardons, perfect for a date night, this ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly kanom jeen is a unique blend of flavors and textures. The combination of ingredients creates a rich and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced galangal and cook until fragrant.
Add the lardons and cook until crispy.
Add the khus khus and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
Combine the cooked noodles and the creamy sauce, and season with salt to taste.
Serve the kanom jeen hot, garnished with additional khus khus and galangal if desired.
